newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sin Soon Huat sees good full year results.
newsitem.headline: Sin Soon Huat sees good full year results.

text.p: Industrial hardware maker Sin Soon Huat said on Wednesday it expects to perform satisfactorily in its 1996/97 financial year ending May 31.
It said in a statement that barring unforseen circumstances it should see good full year results.
The company reported that half-year net profits were up 30 percent at $6.2 million for the six months ended Novermber 30.
It said the group was profitable due to growth in regional sales of industrial hardware products.
Its decision to increase and enlarge regional satellite warehouses in strategic locations to meet customer needs in oil and gas projects also boosted profits, the statement said.
